race.comment: Looks a wide open affair. Former Victorian DIVINE JUSTICE (7) just missed the placings when having the first run for the new stable and will have taken some benefit from that hit-out. Has placed four of five over this distance range and should find this easier than what she faced down south. Sure to be right there when the judge calls a halt. VANZADEE (13) is one from one around this circuit and will appreciate the drop back in grade here. Watch for sharp improvement. EXCEED PERFECTION (9) strips fitter second-up from the break and maps nicely for this from gate four. Top-three aspirations. The well-related HOMERIC (6) (half to G3 winner Xidaki) gets the services of Wiggins in the saddle and can feature despite the sticky draw. COMIN'HOMETOYOU (1) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be discounted lightly.
